title: Tobacco, vaping and nicotine products: online sale and advertising
summary: About 47 jurisdictions ban e-cigarette sale (per Campaign for Tobacco-Free Kids, July 2025); Japan and Australia use medicinal/pharmacy models. Most countries ban tobacco advertising and some EU states ban online tobacco sale. Lawful markets: US (FDA authorised), Canada, EU with regulation.

countries.name: France

countries.name: Germany

countries.name: New Zealand
